shots.prompt: Slow aerial drone flight over the skyline of a large German city at dawn, glass towers, river with bridges, mist, first light on the horizon. {S1}
Slow-motion medium shot of tired commuters with umbrellas waiting at a tram stop in drizzle in a German city at dawn, nobody looks at the camera. {S1}
Close-up of the hands of an elderly man carefully counting coins at a supermarket checkout counter, shallow focus, quiet and dignified. {S1}
A young woman stands at a rain-streaked apartment window at dawn, looking out pensively, soft backlight, slow push-in. {S1}
Majestic sunrise over a German city skyline, god rays breaking through clouds, slow cinematic push-in, hopeful mood, lens flare. {S1}
Pitch-dark underground garage. The headlights of a black Porsche 911 suddenly ignite, low-angle front shot, the camera slowly pushes in, light haze in the beams, reflections on polished concrete. {S}

Luxury penthouse at golden hour, city skyline behind floor-to-ceiling windows. {KANDIDAT} sits on a cognac leather sofa holding a small espresso cup, looks straight into the camera and says in German, calm, deep and completely serious: "Geld allein macht nicht glücklich." He takes a slow sip of espresso, pauses, then says: "Viel Geld aber schon." Static medium close-up, subtle slow push-in. No music. {S}
Low tracking shot alongside a black Porsche 911 driving fast through a wet city street at night, neon and streetlight reflections streaking across the glossy paint, camera car perspective. {S}
A white private jet on the tarmac at golden hour, a red carpet leads up to its open airstairs, slow dolly forward, heat haze. {S}
Extreme macro close-up of a man in a navy suit adjusting a gold cufflink, a luxurious steel chronograph watch with a deep blue dial on his wrist, light glints on the polished case. {S}
Rooftop infinity pool of a penthouse overlooking a city skyline at sunset, still turquoise water, sun loungers, slow lateral slide. {S}
Slow motion: champagne is poured from a dark green bottle with a gold shield-shaped label into the top of a tall champagne glass pyramid, golden bubbles cascading, dark elegant background. {S}
Aerial shot of a black helicopter flying past snow-capped Swiss Alps towards a luxurious modern wooden chalet on a mountain ridge, crisp blue sky. {S}
{KANDIDAT} reclines in a private first-class suite on an airliner, holding a glass of champagne, looking out of the window above the clouds, warm cabin light. {S}
Close-up: a matte black metal credit card without any text or logo slides slowly across a polished white marble table towards the camera, a manicured hand releases it, soft reflections. {S}
Aerial drone push-in towards an enormous modern villa made of glass and white concrete on a lake shore, manicured lawn, large fountain, tall black electric gate in front, golden hour. {S}

{KANDIDAT} stands in front of the closed black gate of an enormous modern glass villa, hands folded in front of him, statesmanlike posture, looks directly into the camera and says in English with a slight German accent, slowly, calmly and with complete seriousness: "If you're homeless, just buy a home." Then he holds eye contact silently without moving. Birds chirping, a fountain splashing softly. No music. Static medium shot, eye level. {S}
Low-angle shot: a massive black electric gate of a luxury villa slowly and majestically swings open, revealing a long illuminated driveway and fountain, golden hour backlight, slow push-in. {S}
{BERATERIN} sits at a trading desk in front of six huge curved monitors showing colourful stock charts and candlestick graphs in a dark room, slow dolly around her, monitor glow on her face. {S}
Close-up of {BERATERIN}: stock chart lines reflect in her gold-rimmed glasses, she types calmly on a keyboard, shallow depth of field, blue and gold monitor light. {S}

Time-lapse in a beige municipal meeting room: six people sit motionless around a table with coffee cups and folders while the wall clock hands spin rapidly and the daylight outside changes; one person slowly turns a page of an empty flip chart. {S5}
A clerk at an office desk slowly disappears behind an absurdly tall tower of grey ring binders and paper stacks reaching the ceiling, then a hand bangs a rubber stamp onto a form in close-up. {S5}

Dark meeting room, a projector beam cuts through dust, the audience around the table is asleep, one man snores with his head on the table, the presenter clicks the remote with a monotonous expression. {S5}

A festive technology conference stage with blue spotlights and an applauding audience; the presenter turns proudly to the giant plain bright blue projection screen behind him, then freezes and stares at it awkwardly while the applause dies down. {S5}

Night, interior of a luxury Porsche sports car with cream leather seats and ambient lighting, city lights bokeh outside. {KANDIDAT} sits in the driver's seat, presses a small button on the center console with a soft click, then turns his head and looks directly into the camera and says in German, deep, calm and dead serious: "Während andere noch diskutieren, haben wir bereits die Sitzheizung eingeschaltet." Engine idling softly. No music. Medium close-up from the passenger side. {S}
Epic aerial drone shot following a black sports car along winding serpentine roads of a Swiss Alpine pass at golden hour, snow-capped peaks, long shadows. {S}
Static low camera on an empty Alpine road: a black Porsche 911 launches from standstill and accelerates hard away from the camera, disappearing around the bend, dust and heat haze. {S}
Camera tilts up along the glass facade of a soaring skyscraper of a financial district at golden hour, reflections of clouds, lens flare. {S}

Slow motion: {KANDIDAT} walks confidently towards the camera through a vast black-and-white marble lobby of a private bank, two assistants in navy suits follow, golden light, symmetrical composition. {S}
A white private jet takes off from a runway into a blazing orange sunset, side view, heat shimmer, slow-motion. {S}
